title: Motion Analysis of Sit-to-Stand Movements in Children With Spastic Diplegia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare movement variations before and after the loaded training, with kinematics, kinetics, and electromyography, in children with spastic diplegia and to further discuss mechanisms of the loaded training.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed as spastic diplegia
* Aged between 5 and 12 years
* Able to perform the STS movements without assistance
* Able to cooperate and understand commands given

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe musculoskeletal deformity or pain on lower extremities
* Botulism injection in the past 3 months or major operations in the preceding 6 months on lower extremities
* Uncontrolled epilepsy
* Major sensory deficits, such as blindness or deafness
